751-2079-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

720-883-1806-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-883-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2131-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-6495-6972--112.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3773-6495-6972--112.notes:
The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3340-4067-7902.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters, Fateful Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
955-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2557-2919-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-2919-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

1651-2573-5921-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2573-5921-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-2573-5921-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1482-4195-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1482-4195-4574-6650.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

500-813-2081.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scholar of the Ages and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Scholar of the Ages tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand, as well as up to two additional instants or sorceries.
Repeat.

2921-3240-6462-6560.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4210-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-4210-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple indestructible.
2034-3490-4210-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2051-2546-3872-4578.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-3872-4578.description:
Activate Tranquil Thicket's cycling ability by paying {G} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Tranquil Thicket ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Land's Edge ability, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Tranquil Thicket and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-1633-2397-3503-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Spectral Arcanist is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-2397-3503-5195.description:
Activate Spectral Arcanist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Spectral Arcanist.
Resolve a Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing  you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2232-2506-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
The Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1018-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Skullwinder.
Skullwinder enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1308-2367-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1376-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Priest of Titania
1376-5200.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Priest of Titania
Repeat.
1376-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1518-1987-3227-5116.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3227-5116.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

539-1247-2071.notablePrerequisites:
Wolfwillow Haven attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-2071.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
